name: hive
description: Hyper Intelligence for Verified Engineering command cockpit and Windows desktop companion.
author: HIVE contributors

scripts.build:desktop-renderer: npm run typecheck:desktop-renderer && vite build --config desktop/vite.config.ts
scripts.build:desktop: npm run desktop:assets && npm run build:core && npm run build:desktop-shell && npm run build:desktop-worker && npm run build:desktop-renderer
scripts.test:desktop: npm run test:desktop-shell && npm run test:desktop-renderer
scripts.desktop:e2e: npm run build:desktop && playwright test --config tests/e2e/playwright.config.ts
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run build:desktop && electron-builder --win nsis portable --x64 --publish never && npm run desktop:checksum
scripts.test: node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-reporter=spec tests/coder-safety.test.mjs tests/coder-cli.test.mjs tests/coder-persistence.test.mjs tests/coder-phase2.5.test.mjs tests/coder-phase3.test.mjs tests/providers.test.mjs tests/ui.test.mjs tests/tui.test.mjs tests/scout.test.mjs tests/coding-foundation.test.mjs tests/coding-services.test.mjs tests/coding-agent-loop.test.mjs tests/coding-cli-options.test.mjs tests/coding-command.test.mjs tests/coding-session.test.mjs tests/run-report.test.mjs tests/subagents-tui.test.mjs tests/tui-runtime.test.mjs tests/desktop-core.test.mjs tests/desktop-services.test.mjs tests/desktop-electron.test.mjs tests/coding-verification.test.mjs tests/chat-engine.test.mjs tests/chat-core.test.mjs tests/hivebot.test.mjs tests/chat-sessions.test.mjs tests/chat-streaming.test.mjs
